# Cloudflare Sensitive Data Detection

Cloudflare Sensitive Data Detection helps identify data leaks from your origin servers by scanning response bodies for patterns of common sensitive data like PII, financial information, and secrets.

> Links below point directly to Markdown versions of each page. Any page can also be retrieved as Markdown by sending an `Accept: text/markdown` header to the page's URL without the `index.md` suffix (for example, `curl -H "Accept: text/markdown" https://developers.cloudflare.com/waf/managed-rules/reference/sensitive-data-detection/`).
>
> For other Cloudflare products, see the [Cloudflare documentation directory](https://developers.cloudflare.com/llms.txt).

## Cloudflare Sensitive Data Detection documentation pages

- [Cloudflare Sensitive Data Detection](https://developers.cloudflare.com/waf/managed-rules/reference/sensitive-data-detection/index.md): Detect sensitive data like credit card numbers in HTTP responses.
